facts.claim: 第一节讲“What do you get if you cross …?”格式：作者说这类笑话常被儿童喜爱，因而显得简单，其实一点也不简单
facts.quote: Jokes beginning with ‘What do you get if you cross …’ are often beloved by children, which can give the impression that they’re incredibly straightforward, but they’re anything but.

facts.claim: 同节把这类格式的走向分成两路：一路落到谐音双关（羊与袋鼠杂交得到 woolly jumper，既羊毛套衫又会跳），一路更超现实（大象与袋鼠杂交导致澳大利亚遍地大洞）
facts.quote: Sometimes they’re building to a play on words (a sheep crossed with a kangaroo results in, yes, a woolly jumper), while other times it’s a bit more surreal (an elephant crossed with a kangaroo leads to big holes all over Australia)

facts.claim: 第二节（Paraprosdokians）先下定义：尾句反转全句意义的单句笑话，并说它极难写、既傻气又高眉
facts.quote: a paraprosdokian is a one-liner where the end of a sentence transforms the meaning of the beginning of it

facts.claim: 举 Groucho Marx 的“我度过了一个非常愉快的夜晚，但不是今晚”为标准范例
facts.quote: Groucho Marx’s line ‘I’ve had a perfectly wonderful evening, but this wasn’t it’, is a textbook example.

facts.claim: 再举 Stephen King 谈写作时的“我有颗小男孩的心，放在桌上的罐子里”，说明尾句如何把温情意象翻成恐怖
facts.quote: Horror writer Stephen King, when asked about his approach to writing, once said ‘I have the heart of a small boy, in a jar on my desk.’

facts.claim: 第四节讲 travelling salesman / Little Jimmy 笑话：先溯源 stock characters 这一文学戏剧传统，从《天方夜谭》到即兴喜剧
facts.quote: Stock characters are a long literary and dramatic convention – archetypes like the noble knight, the wise old crone and the sad clown date back centuries

facts.claim: Little Jimmy 笑话的核心是小男孩说出难以想象的脏话／醉态／色欲，或无意间泄露父母的私生活，常与双关叠用
facts.quote: Little Jimmy jokes, meanwhile, are based around the idea of a small boy being as unimaginably sweary/drunk/lascivious/offensive as possible

facts.claim: 第五节讲 non-sequitur：拉丁语“不跟随”，转向不仅意外而且全然荒谬无逻辑；九岁上下的孩子最爱编这类笑话
facts.quote: a non-sequitur usually involves a joke or story taking a turn which isn’t just unexpected, it is absurd and nonsensical and involves no logic at all

relations.relation: 两者都靠尾部反转，但规模不同：paraprosdokian 压在一行内，pull back and reveal 可铺到更大篇幅
relations.quote: A similar thing is sometimes referred to as a ‘pull back and reveal’, but that can be on a larger scale

relations.pair: stock characters / travelling salesman 与 Little Jimmy
relations.relation: 古老的角色类型（高贵骑士、智慧老妪、悲伤小丑）被降格成粗俗笑话里的固定人物，靠文化 shorthand 省去交代
relations.quote: These are like really rude versions of that.

relations.pair: 谐音双关 / 超现实 / 有保留的无答案
relations.relation: cross 格式的三条出路：woolly jumper 走双关，澳大利亚大洞走图像荒诞，椅子与仙人掌走“我也不说答案”的自我拆解
relations.quote: or deconstructs its own form by offering a qualified lack of an answer

relations.relation: 作者把 non-sequitur 的流行归到九岁前后的儿童：先给一个标准提问句式，再用与任何问题都无关的胡话作答
relations.quote: Children around the age of nine often get heavily into making up non-sequitur jokes

numbers.meaning: 作者给出的年龄段：九岁上下的孩子热衷自编 non-sequitur 笑话，用“几岁”解释这种格式为何在校园流行
numbers.quote: Children around the age of nine often get heavily into making up non-sequitur jokes

numbers.meaning: 作者用“一行”作为 paraprosdokian 的长度标准，超出这个尺度就归入 pull back and reveal
numbers.quote: while a paraprosdokian does it in, ideally, a line

numbers.meaning: stock characters 的历史跨度：高贵骑士、智慧老妪、悲伤小丑这些原型可上溯数百年
numbers.quote: date back centuries and crop up everywhere from Arabian Nights to the Commedia dell’arte

numbers.meaning: Little Jimmy 笑话的常见体量：一则略粗俗的两行笑话被扩写成更丰富、更傻气的故事
numbers.quote: a slightly rude two-line joke built into a richer, dafter story
